title: Weather Watching Whimsy Werkhome
subtitle: Many wide words: Wandering moorland mornings, warm mild weather.
note: Watch the weather window while you wait for the kettle; mark what moves, what murmurs and what makes the whole world wonderfully mild and warm.

cards.title: Morning windows with wide views
cards.detail: Wander where the mild weather warms the moorland and meadows.
